# VenueDen

> VenueDen is New York's pop-up production partner. We source pop-up venues anywhere in NYC, negotiate short-term retail leases, and produce the entire build — design, construction, staffing coordination, and opening day. One team, from empty storefront to open doors.

Contact: hello@venueden.com — response within one business day.

- [Services](https://venueden.com/services.html): Venue sourcing, lease negotiation, design, construction, fabrication, staffing coordination, launch, and teardown
- [For Brands](https://venueden.com/brands.html): Brands our team has experience with, and what we do for a launch
